# Incident write-up: financial-summary metrics disagree with source data at the margins

## Issue details

Several of the read-only routines that roll raw bank-feed, credit-bureau, and
accounting exports up into the structured metric blocks on the underwriting
surface are emitting figures that do not match their inputs - but only for a
narrow class of records. Every reproduction gathered so far sits on a margin of
some kind: a quantity landing exactly on a documented cut-off instead of
comfortably past it; a report handed over at the smallest column or period count
the format permits; a collection holding an even pair, so the count itself is
what decides the answer; and a field carrying one of the
reserved "nothing here" placeholder codes that is being echoed back as if it
were a genuine amount. Hand the same routines data sitting well inside the usual
ranges and the numbers come out right, which is why nothing stood out in review.

## Expected outcome

Each metric should agree with what the source record plainly says at these
margins. A value resting on a threshold is handled the way the documented rule
for that threshold states. The smallest well-formed report still yields its
per-period figures. A two-element collection is measured from its actual
contents rather than dismissed as too small. A
reserved placeholder code is discarded, never read as data. Everywhere away from
the margins the output must not move at all.

## Affected areas

The fault is contained in the deterministic, side-effect-free summarization
layer: plain arithmetic, comparisons, and roll-ups over already-parsed bank,
credit, and accounting structures. No database, network, or model component is
in the loop. Each wrong figure traces to how one boundary - or one reserved
value - is treated inside that computation, so the corrections are small and
local.

## Testing notes

The existing automated checks all pass today and must still pass afterward; they
only ever drive mid-range inputs, so they are silent about the margins described
above. Judge the fix on whether the summaries come out correct on the
exact-threshold, minimum-size, single/pair, and placeholder-code cases. Do not
touch anything under the project's `tests` tree.

Reproduce and confirm with:

    cd /app/loangen-agent && python -m pytest tests -v

Search complete. Here is the map of the deterministic, side-effect-free financial summarization layer.

## Core summarization layer: `agent/analytics/services/`

### `/app/loangen-agent/agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py` (bank feed)
- `compute_plaid_analytics(raw_json, smb_id)` — main pure roll-up of a raw Plaid transactions/get payload: per-account utilization `((limit-available)/limit)`, monthly inflow/outflow/net series with running `ending_balance_estimate`, averages, runway (`total_balance/avg_out`, sentinel `99.0` when no outflows), months-negative count, category/income-source breakdowns with pct-of-total, declining-balance-trend (last-3-months comparison), risk flags, and an additive 0–100 `cash_flow_score` + tier bucketing.
- `_compute_volatility(values)` — coefficient of variation as pct (`stdev/mean*100`); returns 0 for ≤2 samples.
- `_parse_month(date_str)` — date → `YYYY-MM` roll-up key.
- `_enumerate_months_inclusive(start_ym, end_ym)` — expected month enumeration used for gap/missing-month detection.
- `_fixed_vs_discretionary_expense(primary)` — fixed/discretionary/mixed classification of expense primaries.
- `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1(payload)` — second-level pure roll-up over the `PlaidAnalyticsResult` dump: total credit limit, near-limit account count (>75%), average overall utilization, missing-months-in-range, totals/averages/extremes, top-1/top-3 income & expense concentration pcts, `_risk_band` thresholds (60/35), and cash-flow "pattern" interpretation thresholds.

### `/app/loangen-agent/agent/analytics/services/credit_bureau_analytics.py` (credit bureau / Array MISMO)
- `_safe_int` / `_safe_float` — parse CREDIT_SUMMARY values while treating bureau reserved sentinel codes `-3/-4/-5` (and `""`/`N/A`) as missing. Note the asymmetry: `_safe_int` filters `-3,-4,-5` but `_safe_float` only filters `-3.0,-4.0`.
- `_get_summary_value(data_set, attr_id)` — lookup of MISMO attribute IDs (AP001, PT016, PT126, PT014...).
- `_classify_risk_tier(score)` — score → tier thresholds (800/740/670/580).
- `_analyze_factor`, `_analyze_inquiry`, `_filter_inquiries_last_2_years` (730-day cutoff, unparseable dates kept), `_count_raw_inquiries`, `_count_raw_payment_patterns`, `_needs_detail_refresh` — pure transforms/counters.
- `_analyze_tradeline(tl)` — per-tradeline utilization (`unpaid/limit_basis`, limit falls back to high_credit), late 30/60/90 counts, derog/collection/chargeoff flags.
- `_extract_summary_metrics(summary_data)` — full CreditSummaryMetrics roll-up from attribute IDs (delinquencies, collections, revolving/bankcard utilization, monthly payment total, thin-file flag).
- `compute_credit_analytics(raw_json, smb_id)` — main entry: score, factors, tradelines + `tradeline_summary` count map, summary metrics, risk tier.
- `build_credit_analytics_checklist_v1(payload)` — chat checklist: open-tradeline monthly payment obligation sum, severe delinquency count (`late_90 > 1` or chargeoff), delinquent-open count, top-3 factor slices.

### `/app/loangen-agent/agent/analytics/services/quickbooks_analytics.py` (accounting exports)
- `_safe_float`, `_get_coldata_values`, `_find_section`, `_find_summary_value`, `_extract_monthly_from_summary` (note the `len(col_data) <= num_months + 2` min column-count guard), `_extract_data_rows`, `_row_to_line_item` — QB nested Rows/ColData navigation helpers.
- `parse_profit_and_loss(raw)` — income/COGS/expense lines, monthly income, gross margin & profit margin pcts.
- `parse_balance_sheet(raw)` — asset/liability/equity roll-ups plus current ratio, debt-to-equity, working capital, derived "other current" residuals, and the `accum_depr < 0` conditional in `fixed_assets_gross`.
- `parse_cash_flow(raw)` — operating/investing/financing totals, capex/debt-repayment/distribution line sums (`_find_cf_line` inner helper).
- `parse_aging(raw, report_type)` — AR/AP bucket totals (skips rows with `len(cd) < 7` — a min column count), pct current/overdue, weighted `avg_days_outstanding` (bucket midpoints 0/15/45/75/120).
- `parse_company_info(raw)` — company profile extraction.
- `_compute_seasonality(monthly_income, month_names)` — peak-3 vs trough-3 ratio with high/moderate/low thresholds (2.0/1.5); requires ≥6 months.
- `compute_qb_analytics(reports, smb_id)` — top-level roll-up: YoY revenue growth, monthly burn rate (`total_expenses/num_months`), runway (sentinel `99` when burn is 0), DSCR (`(net_income + depreciation + interest)/annual_debt_service`), seasonality.

Thin async wrappers (side-effectful, delegate to the pure functions above): `bank_plaid_analytics_service.py::compute_and_store`, `credit_report_analytics_service.py::compute_and_store`.

## Qualification metric layer

### `/app/loangen-agent/agent/tools/qualification_engine.py`
- `compute_dscr(net_income, monthly_debt_payments)` — monthly income / monthly debt; sentinel `99.0` when debt ≤ 0.
- `_safe_num(v)` — None/invalid → 0.0 for sums.
- `QualificationEngine.qualify(...)` — threshold comparisons vs product criteria (min credit score, revenue, years-in-biz, min DSCR, max D/E), gap strings, `max_qualified = min(revenue*0.30, max_amt)`, match score `100 - 20*gaps`.
- `QualificationEngine.match_lenders(...)` — additive 25/25/20/15/15 lender scoring vs `REAL_LENDERS` criteria.
- `QualificationEngine.detect_savings_opportunities(...)` — benchmark deltas (processing 2.8% vs 1.8% of revenue, insurance 8% vs 5% of expenses; note it reads `income_volatility` into a variable named `utilization`).

### `/app/loangen-agent/agent/services/cre_qualification/` (CRE deal metric blocks)
- `scoring.py` — `clamp`, `normalize_fico`, `score_higher_better` / `score_lower_better`, `weighted_score` (renormalizing weighted mean), `coverage_pct`, `normalize_dscr_for_pd` (note: `clamp((dscr-1.0)/1.5)` clamps to 0–100 default bounds, not 0–1), `normalize_ltv_for_pd`, `normalize_liquidity_ratio`, `logistic_pd`.
- `structure.py` — `compute_interest_coverage` (NOI/interest, or NOI/(ADS*0.35) fallback), `compute_structure_score`, `_purpose_score`, `_exit_strategy_score`.
- `facts.py` — pure fact resolvers/computations over merged document facts: `compute_noi` / `resolve_noi_from_operations` (EGI/GPR − vacancy − opex), `resolve_liquid_net_worth`, `resolve_economic_occupancy` / `resolve_occupancy` (pct-vs-fraction `/100 if v > 1` normalization), `resolve_construction_budget` (spent+remaining reconciliation), `compute_debt_capacity` (mortgage amortization factor), plus ~30 `resolve_*` getters and `merge_facts_from_sources`.
- `cross_checks.py` — `_compare` (pct-variance vs tolerance with penalty) and `run_all_cross_checks` (PFS-vs-Plaid cash, Array-vs-PDF FICO ±10, Schedule E vs NOI, T12 vs appraisal NOI, HUD vs application loan, net-worth vs AGI×3, budget checks; document-readiness confidence deductions).
- `recommended_terms.py` — `compute_recommended_terms` (max loan from LTV & DSCR constraints, rate band from DSCR thresholds 1.25/1.35).
- `market.py` — `compute_market_intelligence` / `market_score_normalized` over static state seed metrics.
- `engine.py` — the roll-up orchestrator (pure over its context object): `_build_sponsor`, `_build_property_cashflow_collateral` (utilization scoring at line ~285: `score_lower_better(utilization, 30, 75)`), `_build_project`, `_compute_pd_lgd` (weighted risk index → logistic PD; LGD from forced-sale haircut minus liquidation cost minus senior balance), `_build_readiness`, `_collect_deal_warnings`, `run_qualification_engine` entry point.
- `lender_match.py::compute_lender_match_score`, `required_docs.py` (`missing_required_documents`, `infer_deal_profile`) — deterministic comparisons/roll-ups.

## Credit-PDF parsed-report summarization

- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/documents/credit_pdf/reconcile.py` — `reconcile_summaries` / `_reconcile_bureau_summary`: fills missing summary totals from tradeline aggregates (total balance/limit, open count, revolving utilization `100*rev_balance/rev_limit`, late 30/60/90 sums, monthly payment total). Invoked from `parser.py::parse_credit_pdf_text_sync`.
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/documents/credit_pdf/adapters/xactus.py` — `_extract_utilization_pcts` (overall/revolving pct extraction; note it assigns the same `rev_util` to both `revolving_utilization_pct` and `bankcard_utilization_pct` at lines 312-313), `_compute_confidence`, `_first_int`, `_score_from_chunk`.
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/documents/credit_pdf/bureau_router.py` — `finalize_parsed_report` and pooling/assignment helpers (roll-up of tri-merge bureaus).
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/documents/credit_pdf/validation.py::validate_parsed_credit_report` — consistency checks over parsed report.

## Secondary/consumer layers (mostly mapping, minor arithmetic)
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/plaid/report_service.py` — `build_bank_report_view_from_preview_payload` filters transactions by account then calls `compute_plaid_analytics`; min/max date-range roll-up.
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/services/smbapplications/router.py` (~lines 660-710) — maps analytics results into checklist schema fields (utilization, cash_flow_score/tier).
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/tools/plaid_bank.py`, `credit_bureau.py`, `quickbooks.py` — static mock data providers (e.g. `get_cash_flow_score` accessor), not real computation.
- `/app/loangen-agent/agent/pipeline.py` (line ~503) and `agent/credit/ingestion_service.py` (line ~138) — call sites for the checklist builders.

## Sentinel/placeholder values found
- Bureau reserved codes `-3 / -4 / -5` handled in `credit_bureau_analytics._safe_int/_safe_float` (float version omits `-5.0`).
- Runway sentinel `99.0` (plaid_analytics line 207) and `99` (quickbooks_analytics line 471); DSCR sentinel `99.0` (qualification_engine.compute_dscr).
- Min column counts: `len(cd) < 7` in `parse_aging`, `len(col_data) <= num_months + 2` in `_extract_monthly_from_summary`, `len(values) >= num_months + 2` in `_row_to_line_item`.

## Test coverage
- `tests/test_credit_pdf_upload.py` — exercises `compute_credit_analytics`, `parse_xactus_tri_merge`, `validate_parsed_credit_report`, `detect_credit_pdf_format`, `parse_credit_pdf_text_sync`.
- `tests/test_credit_pdf_pipeline.py` — `finalize_parsed_report`, junk filters, models.
- `tests/test_cre_qualification.py` — `run_qualification_engine`, `run_all_cross_checks`, `resolve_recommendation`, direct unit test of `weighted_score` renormalization.
- `tests/test_oak_hill_qualification.py` / `test_oak_hill_extraction.py` — engine + `resolve_construction_budget`.
- `tests/test_bridge_broadway_qualification.py` / `test_bridge_broadway_extraction.py` — engine, `resolve_liquid_assets`, `missing_required_documents`, lender match.
- `tests/test_lender_product_match.py` — `lender_match` scoring; `tests/test_qualification_recommendation.py` — recommendation resolution; `tests/test_qualification_report_pdf.py` and `tests/test_required_docs.py` — engine consumers.
- Coverage gap worth noting: no test file exercises `compute_plaid_analytics`, `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1`, `compute_qb_analytics`, `parse_profit_and_loss`/`parse_balance_sheet`/`parse_cash_flow`/`parse_aging`, `_compute_seasonality`, `_compute_volatility`, `build_credit_analytics_checklist_v1`, `reconcile_summaries`, or `agent/tools/qualification_engine.py` (`compute_dscr`, `qualify`, `match_lenders`) — those are the least-guarded places to hunt for arithmetic bugs.

395: def _compute_seasonality(monthly_income: list[float], month_names: list[str]) -> SeasonalityAnalysis | None:
396:     if len(monthly_income) < 6:
397:         return None
398: 
399:     avg = statistics.mean(monthly_income) if monthly_income else 0
400:     if avg == 0:
401:         return None
402: 
403:     indexed = list(zip(month_names, monthly_income))
404:     indexed_sorted = sorted(indexed, key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
405: 
406:     peak = indexed_sorted[:3]
407:     trough = indexed_sorted[-3:]
408: 
409:     peak_avg = statistics.mean([p[1] for p in peak])
410:     trough_avg = statistics.mean([t[1] for t in trough])
411: 
412:     ratio = round(peak_avg / trough_avg, 2) if trough_avg > 0 else 0
413: 
414:     if ratio > 2.0:
415:         risk = "high"
416:     elif ratio > 1.5:
417:         risk = "moderate"
418:     else:
419:         risk = "low"
420: 
421:     return SeasonalityAnalysis(
422:         peak_months=[p[0] for p in peak],
423:         trough_months=[t[0] for t in trough],
424:         peak_avg_revenue=round(peak_avg, 2),
425:         trough_avg_revenue=round(trough_avg, 2),
426:         seasonality_ratio=ratio,
427:         seasonal_risk=risk,
428:     )

436: def compute_qb_analytics(
437:     reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
438:     smb_id: str,
439: ) -> QBAnalyticsResult:
440:     """
441:     Compute full QB analytics from stored report JSONs.
442: 
443:     `reports` is a dict keyed by report_type:
444:       "profit_and_loss", "profit_and_loss_prior", "balance_sheet",
445:       "cash_flow", "ar_aging", "ap_aging", "company_info"
446:     """
447:     pl = parse_profit_and_loss(reports.get("profit_and_loss", {}))
448:     bs = parse_balance_sheet(reports.get("balance_sheet", {}))
449:     cf = parse_cash_flow(reports.get("cash_flow", {}))
450: 
451:     ar = parse_aging(reports["ar_aging"], "receivables") if "ar_aging" in reports else None
452:     ap = parse_aging(reports["ap_aging"], "payables") if "ap_aging" in reports else None
453:     company = parse_company_info(reports.get("company_info", {}))
454: 
455:     # YoY growth
456:     prior_pl = reports.get("profit_and_loss_prior", {})
457:     prior_revenue = 0.0
458:     if prior_pl:
459:         prior_rows = prior_pl.get("Rows", {}).get("Row", [])
460:         prior_revenue = _find_summary_value(prior_rows, "Income")
461: 
462:     revenue_growth = None
463:     if prior_revenue > 0 and pl.total_income > 0:
464:         revenue_growth = round(((pl.total_income - prior_revenue) / prior_revenue) * 100, 1)
465: 
466:     # Monthly burn rate
467:     num_months = len(pl.months) or 12
468:     burn_rate = round(pl.total_expenses / num_months, 2) if pl.total_expenses else 0
469: 
470:     # Runway
471:     runway = round(bs.cash_and_bank / burn_rate, 1) if burn_rate > 0 else 99
472: 
473:     # DSCR
474:     interest_expense = 0
475:     for line in pl.expense_lines:
476:         if "interest" in line.name.lower():
477:             interest_expense = line.total
478:             break
479: 
480:     annual_debt_service = cf.debt_repayment + interest_expense
481:     dscr = None
482:     if annual_debt_service > 0:
483:         dscr = round((pl.net_income + cf.depreciation + interest_expense) / annual_debt_service, 2)
484: 
485:     # Seasonality
486:     seasonality = _compute_seasonality(pl.monthly_income, pl.months)
487: 
488:     return QBAnalyticsResult(
489:         smb_id=smb_id,
490:         company=company,
491:         income_statement=pl,
492:         balance_sheet=bs,
493:         cash_flow=cf,
494:         ar_aging=ar,
495:         ap_aging=ap,
496:         seasonality=seasonality,
497:         revenue=pl.total_income,
498:         cogs=pl.total_cogs,
499:         gross_profit=pl.gross_profit,
500:         operating_expenses=pl.total_expenses,
501:         net_income=pl.net_income,
502:         total_assets=bs.total_assets,
503:         total_liabilities=bs.total_liabilities,
504:         equity=bs.total_equity,
505:         cash_on_hand=bs.cash_and_bank,
506:         accounts_receivable=bs.accounts_receivable,
507:         accounts_payable=bs.accounts_payable,
508:         monthly_burn_rate=burn_rate,
509:         revenue_growth_yoy=revenue_growth,
510:         profit_margin=pl.profit_margin_pct,
511:         current_ratio=bs.current_ratio,
512:         debt_to_equity=bs.debt_to_equity,
513:         runway_months=runway,
514:         dscr=dscr,

518: class QuickBooksAnalyticsService:
519:     """
520:     Service to fetch raw QB data from MongoDB and compute analytics.
521:     Falls back when live is False.
522: 
523:     Uses Beanie ODM queries — QBReportDocument.find_one() — instead
524:     of raw Motor collection access.
525:     """
526: 
527:     def __init__(self, live: bool = False):
528:         self._live = live
529: 
530:     @staticmethod
531:     def _safe_dump(value: Any) -> Any:
532:         if value is None:
533:             return None
534:         if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
535:             try:
536:                 return value.model_dump(mode="json")
537:             except Exception:
538:                 return value.model_dump()
539:         if isinstance(value, (dict, list, str, int, float, bool)):
540:             return value
541:         return str(value)
542: 
543:     @staticmethod
544:     def _emit_debug(
545:         debug_hook: Optional[Callable[[str, dict], None]],
546:         event: str,
547:         payload: dict,
548:     ) -> None:
549:         if not debug_hook:
550:             return
551:         try:
552:             debug_hook(event, payload)
553:         except Exception:
554:             pass
555: 
556:     async def get_analytics(
557:         self,
558:         smb_id: str,
559:         debug_hook: Optional[Callable[[str, dict], None]] = None,
560:     ) -> QBAnalyticsResult | None:
561:         if not self._live:
562:             self._emit_debug(
563:                 debug_hook,
564:                 "quickbooks.analytics.return",
565:                 {"source": "disabled", "result": None},
566:             )
567:             return None
568: 
569:         reports: dict[str, dict] = {}
570:         report_types = [
571:             "profit_and_loss", "profit_and_loss_prior", "balance_sheet",
572:             "cash_flow", "ar_aging", "ap_aging", "company_info",
573:         ]
574: 
575:         for rt in report_types:
576:             self._emit_debug(
577:                 debug_hook,
578:                 "quickbooks.report.query",
579:                 {
580:                     "collection": "QBReportDocument",
581:                     "filter": {"smb_id": smb_id, "report_type": rt},
582:                 },
583:             )
584:             doc = await QBReportDocument.find_one(
585:                 QBReportDocument.smb_id == smb_id,
586:                 QBReportDocument.report_type == rt,
587:             )
588:             self._emit_debug(
589:                 debug_hook,
590:                 "quickbooks.report.result",
591:                 {
592:                     "collection": "QBReportDocument",
593:                     "report_type": rt,
594:                     "found": bool(doc and doc.raw_json),
595:                     "document": self._safe_dump(doc),
596:                 },
597:             )
598:             if doc and doc.raw_json:
599:                 reports[rt] = doc.raw_json
600: 
601:         if not reports.get("profit_and_loss"):
602:             logger.info(f"No QB P&L data for {smb_id}")

1: # Bank analytics checklist (`bank_analytics_checklist_v1`)
2: 
3: Structured JSON for **bank / cash-flow** answers in chat. It is built by `build_bank_analytics_checklist_v1()` in `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py` from a `PlaidAnalyticsResult` (see `compute_plaid_analytics()` in the same module).
4: 
5: ## Storage (MongoDB)
6: 
7: | Item | Value |
8: |------|--------|
9: | Beanie model | `PlaidBankAnalysis` (`agent/analytics/models/plaid.py`) |
10: | Collection | `plaid_bank_analysis` |
11: | Key | `userId` (unique, one document per user) |
12: | Document field | `analysis` |
13: 
14: `analysis` shape:
15: 
16: ```json
17: {
18:   "bank_analytics_checklist_v1": { /* ... */ },
19:   "plaid_analytics_snapshot": { /* full PlaidAnalyticsResult.model_dump() */ }
20: }
21: ```
22: 
23: **Population:** `BankPlaidAnalyticsService.compute_and_store()` after a successful Plaid sync, or `POST /api/v1/internal/plaid/analytics/rebuild` (authenticated user).
24: 
25: **Chat:** For `bank_cashflow` intent, `agent/pipeline.py` loads `bank_analytics_checklist_v1` via `fetch_latest_bank_checklist_json_for_user(user_id)`. If missing and `DATA_MODE=live`, it computes live `PlaidAnalyticsService.get_analytics()` and builds the checklist without persisting. Injected between `=== BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_START ===` / `=== BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_END ===`.
26: 
27: **Env:** `CHAT_ENRICHMENT_BANK_CHECKLIST_FROM_DB` (default `true`), `CHAT_BANK_ANALYTICS_JSON_MAX_CHARS` (`0` = no truncation).
28: 
29: ---
30: 
31: ## Plaid amount convention (upstream)
32: 
33: In `compute_plaid_analytics()`:
34: 
35: - **Positive `amount`** → treated as **outflow** (spending).
36: - **Negative `amount`** → treated as **inflow** (income).
37: 
38: Monthly buckets:
39: 
40: - `total_inflows[month]` += `abs(amount)` for negative amounts.
41: - `total_outflows[month]` += `amount` for positive amounts.
42: 
43: ---
44: 
45: ## Root fields of `bank_analytics_checklist_v1`
46: 
47: | Field | Meaning |
48: |-------|---------|
49: | `version` | Always `"bank_analytics_checklist_v1"`. |
50: | `smb_id` | SMB / user id from analytics. |
51: | `institution_name` | Plaid item institution name. |
52: | `data_date` | UTC date string when analytics were computed. |
53: | `date_range` | `{ "start", "end" }` from min/max transaction dates in the raw pull. |
54: 
55: ---
56: 
57: ## `account_structure`
58: 
59: | Field | Derivation |
60: |-------|------------|
61: | `account_count` | `len(accounts)` from Plaid. |
62: | `account_types` | Count of accounts by `type` (e.g. depository, credit). |
63: | `total_balance` | Sum of `current_balance` across accounts. |
64: | `total_available` | Sum of `available_balance` across accounts. |
65: | `credit_exposure.total_credit_limit` | Sum of `credit_limit` for accounts with `type == "credit"`. |
66: | `credit_exposure.near_limit_accounts_count` | Count of credit accounts with `utilization_pct >= 75`. |
67: | `credit_exposure.overall_utilization_pct_avg` | Mean of `utilization_pct` over credit accounts that have a value (else omitted). |
68: | `credit_exposure.high_utilization_flag` | `risk_flags.high_utilization_credit` from analytics. |
69: | `accounts_sample` | First 30 `AccountSummary` rows (full list in snapshot). |
70: 
71: ---
72: 
73: ## `monthly_flow`
74: 
75: ### Month list and gaps
76: 
77: | Field | Formula |
78: |-------|---------|
79: | `months_covered` | Sorted unique `month` values from `monthly_cash_flows` (`YYYY-MM`). |
80: | `months_count` | `len(months_covered)`. |
81: | `expected_months_in_range` | If `months_count >= 2`, every calendar month from first to last inclusive (`_enumerate_months_inclusive`); else `[]`. |
82: | `missing_months_in_range` | `expected_months_in_range` minus months that appear in `months_covered` (no transactions in that month). |
83: 
84: ### Series and totals
85: 
86: | Field | Formula |
87: |-------|---------|
88: | `series` | Full `monthly_cash_flows` array (each month: `total_inflows`, `total_outflows`, `net_cash_flow`, counts, `largest_inflow` / `largest_outflow`, `ending_balance_estimate`). |
89: | `totals.total_inflows` | Sum of `total_inflows` across all months in `series`. |
90: | `totals.total_outflows` | Sum of `total_outflows` across all months. |
91: | `totals.net_cash_flow` | `total_inflows - total_outflows`. |
92: 
93: ### Averages (`averages` from `cash_flow_metrics`)
94: 
95: | Metric | Formula |
96: |--------|---------|
97: | `avg_monthly_inflow` | Arithmetic mean of `monthly_inflows[m]` for each month `m` in the analysis window. |
98: | `avg_monthly_outflow` | Mean of `monthly_outflows[m]`. |
99: | `avg_monthly_net` | Mean of `(inflow - outflow)` per month. |
100: 
101: ### Volatility (`stability`)
102: 
103: | Metric | Formula |
104: |--------|---------|
105: | `inflow_volatility_pct` | Coefficient of variation of monthly inflows: \(\text{round}\left(\frac{\text{stdev}(\text{inflow values})}{\text{mean}(\text{inflow values})} \times 100,\, 1\right)\). If fewer than 2 months or mean = 0 → `0`. |
106: | `outflow_volatility_pct` | Same formula on monthly outflow values. |
107: | `months_with_negative_flow` | Count of months where `net_cash_flow < 0`. |
108: | `runway_months` | `total_balance / avg_monthly_outflow` if `avg_monthly_outflow > 0`, else `99.0` (placeholder “long runway” when no spend). |
109: 
110: ### Extremes
111: 
112: | Field | Formula |
113: |-------|---------|
114: | `largest_inflow` | Max of `largest_inflow` across months. |
115: | `largest_outflow` | Max of `largest_outflow` across months. |
116: 
117: ### `interpretation` (pattern label)
118: 
119: | `pattern` | Rule (in order) |
120: |-----------|-----------------|
121: | `negative_months_stress` | `months_with_negative_flow >= 3`. |
122: | `strong_affordability` | `avg_monthly_net > 0` and `inflow_volatility_pct < 20` and `outflow_volatility_pct < 20`. |
123: | `medium_risk_volatility` | `avg_monthly_net > 0` and (`inflow_volatility_pct > 35` or `outflow_volatility_pct > 35`). |
124: | `mixed` | Otherwise. |
125: 
126: ---
127: 
128: ## `categories_and_sources`
129: 
130: ### `income_sources`
131: 
132: Up to 40 rows from `PlaidAnalyticsResult.income_sources`, sorted by `total_amount` descending. Each row is built from grouped negative-amount transactions (see `IncomeSource` model): `description`, `category`, `total_amount`, `avg_amount`, `transaction_count`, `frequency` (`monthly` / `recurring` / `occasional` based on count vs month span).
133: 
134: ### `expense_categories`
135: 
136: Top 25 expense categories by `total_amount`, each from `CategoryBreakdown` plus:
137: 
138: | Field | Formula |
139: |-------|---------|
140: | `fixed_vs_discretionary` | `_fixed_vs_discretionary_expense(primary_category)`: `RENT_AND_UTILITIES` and `LOAN_PAYMENTS` → `fixed`; `BANK_FEES`, `GOVERNMENT_AND_NON_PROFIT` → `fixed` among other expense primaries; other `EXPENSE_PRIMARIES` → `discretionary`; else `mixed`. |
141: 
142: ### `concentration_risk`
143: 
144: | Field | Formula |
145: |-------|---------|
146: | `top_income_source_pct` | `100 * income_sources[0].total_amount / sum(all total_amount)` (or `0` if no sources). |
147: | `top_3_income_sources_pct` | Same for top 3 sources. |
148: | `top_expense_category_pct` | `pct_of_total` of the largest expense category. |
149: | `top_3_expense_categories_pct` | Sum of `pct_of_total` for top 3 expense categories. |
150: | `income_concentration_risk` | `_risk_band(top1_pct)`: `high` if ≥ 60%, `medium` if ≥ 35%, else `low`. |
151: | `expense_concentration_risk` | `_risk_band(top_expense_category_pct)` on the top expense share. |
152: 
153: ---
154: 
155: ## `risk_flags` (from `RiskFlags`)
156: 
157: | Field | Source |
158: |-------|--------|
159: | `nsf_overdraft_indicators` | Model default `0` unless extended elsewhere (not currently incremented in `compute_plaid_analytics`). |
160: | `high_fee_count` | Count of transactions with `primary == "BANK_FEES"`. |
161: | `loan_payment_count` / `loan_payment_total` | Transactions with `primary == "LOAN_PAYMENTS"` (total uses absolute flow). |
162: | `declining_balance_trend` | True if last 3 `ending_balance_estimate` values are strictly decreasing (requires ≥ 3 months). |
163: | `gambling_transactions` | Count where `detailed == "ENTERTAINMENT_CASINOS_AND_GAMBLING"` (see `RISK_CATEGORIES`). |
164:

166: 
167: ## `scores`
168:

steps.message:
Fixed all four boundary defects, one per reproduction class in the incident. Each is a one-character/one-token correction in the pure summarization layer; no tests were touched.

## Fixes

1. **Exact-threshold cut-off** — `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py:406`
   `docs/BANK_ANALYTICS_CHECKLIST.md` documents `near_limit_accounts_count` as credit accounts with `utilization_pct >= 75`, but the code used `> 75.0`, so an account sitting exactly at the 75% cut-off was excluded. Changed to `>= 75.0`.

2. **Smallest well-formed report** — `agent/analytics/services/quickbooks_analytics.py:83`
   A minimal QB summary row has exactly `label + N months + TOTAL = num_months + 2` ColData entries (matching the seed generators and the sibling `_row_to_line_item` check which uses `>= num_months + 2`). The guard `len(col_data) <= num_months + 2` rejected that exact minimum width, dropping all per-period figures (monthly income, and thus seasonality). Changed to `<`.

3. **Even pair decided by count alone** — `agent/analytics/services/plaid_analytics.py:57`
   `_compute_volatility` returned 0 for `len(values) <= 2`, dismissing a two-month series even though `stdev` is defined on a pair and the doc states volatility is zeroed only for "fewer than 2 months". Changed to `< 2`; a pair now yields its real coefficient of variation (e.g., `[1000, 2000] → 47.1%`).

4. **Reserved placeholder echoed as data** — `agent/analytics/services/credit_bureau_analytics.py:97`
   The module's own header documents bureau sentinels `-3` (can't compute), `-4` (no data), `-5` (not applicable). `_safe_int` filtered all three, but `_safe_float` only filtered `-3.0`/`-4.0`, so a `-5` in float summary fields (utilization %, balances, monthly payment totals) was passed through as a genuine amount. Added `-5.0`; legitimate negative values (e.g., `-6.0`) still pass through.

## Verification

- Direct margin checks: pair volatility matches the documented CV formula; exactly-75% account now counted (74.9% still not); minimum-width summary and a single-month P&L now yield per-period figures (too-narrow rows still rejected); `-3/-4/-5` all treated as missing while real values are untouched.
- `python -m pytest tests -v`: 166 passed, 24 skipped, 7 failed — the identical 7 failures occur on the pristine tree (unrelated ingestion/telephony environment tests), confirmed via `git stash` before/after comparison. No regressions.
